description: This file defines a test subclass of CalendarSync with dependency injection capabilities, used specifically for unit testing. It provides methods to create and reset test instances with mock dependencies and exposes internal components for verification.

classes.name: TestableCalendarSync
classes.description: A subclass of CalendarSync designed for unit testing with dependency injection and singleton management. It allows creation of test instances with mock dependencies, access to internal components, and resetting singleton state between tests.

methods.name: createTestInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create a test instance of TestableCalendarSync with optional custom dependencies, defaulting to fake implementations.

methods.name: resetTestInstance
methods.description: Static method to reset the singleton test instance and CalendarSync internal singleton state.

methods.name: getRepository
methods.description: Returns the CalendarAccountRepository used in the test instance.

methods.name: getValidator
methods.description: Returns the CalendarAccountValidator used in the test instance.

methods.name: getOrchestrator
methods.description: Returns the CalendarSyncOrchestrator used in the test instance.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration array used in the test instance.

methods.name: getProviderRegistry
methods.description: Returns the CalendarProviderRegistry used in the test instance.
